content: OTel GenAI semantic conventions still in Development/experimental status as of 2026. Core attrs: gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.response.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, gen_ai.response.finish_reasons, gen_ai.operation.name (chat/embeddings/execute_tool). OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental opts into latest attribute set. Content capture (prompts/completions) via gen_ai.input.messages/gen_ai.output.messages is opt-in only.
